tx:
The following actions will give a chance to drop this pet:
• excavating artefacts and materials at a Digsite
• restoring artefacts at an archaeologist's workbench
• powering a tetracompass 
The following actions will not give a chance to drop this pet:
• conducting research
• adding rex skeleton fragments to the Rex skeleton on Anachronia
• charging the pylons at the Kharid-et Dig Site
• using an Archaeology skill training dummy

Gaining this item is based on the amount of experience awarded at once; the more experience granted per item made, the greater the chance of gaining this pet. The chance is not affected by experience boosters.
In a purely mathematical format, the chance f of receiving the pet on any particular action is
f = \frac{(B / 40) \times S}{50,000,000}
Where:
• B is the base experience per action
• S is the virtual skill level. At 200 million experience, a flat bonus of 200 is applied to this value

sc: The Devourer's Guard is a main-hand Necromancy siphon dropped by Amascut, the Devourer.
It is obtained by mining Rock debris, a fallen rock, which is one of the random events on the Battle of Lumbridge battlefield.
The rock fragment will have large green crystals protruding from its surface can be mined to obtain a Divine shard.
The best way for a player to do this is to mine a fallen rock as soon as it falls in order to obtain a shard, then use the player's faction token to teleport to their god's camp.
It was made by combining a gold charm with 8 spirit shards and a Raw chicken.

Spirit gems, which are dropped by all monsters that drop a single charm and could be received from the Squeal of Fortune, functioned similarly to Runecrafting pouches and stored uncharged summoning pouches before an update.
Duskrunner's Blade is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override unlocked by using 50 Treasure Hunter Keys during the Smuggler's Spoils promotion from Treasure Hunter.
Elder logs are items that can be obtained by chopping down elder trees by players with level 90 Woodcutting, granting 425 experience per log chopped.
Elite Death Lotus darts are level 88 Ranged weapons from the Eastern Lands, unlocked through a player-owned port.
They can be created 25 at a time at level 92 Fletching, using 1 Death lotus extract, on 25 Death Lotus darts (also requiring 2 lacquer), granting 2,500 experience.
It is made by attaching an elysian sigil, a very rare drop from the Corporeal Beast, to a blessed spirit shield.

An update to the ring of wealth on 15 March 2011 caused the elysian sigil, along with the other sigils, to become a guaranteed drop from the Corporeal Beast if many rings of wealth were worn by a group of players in a friends chat with LootShare enabled.
Enriched bright memories have a chance of being obtained from harvesting bright wisps.
Explosive effigies are a reward from the Effigy Incubator Distraction and Diversion.
They are obtained by talking to Gertrude at her home.
It is not possible to obtain multiple of this item at once from her, but Gertrude will give players more if they are added to make a dinner.

Firemaking ring.x: The Firemaking ring is made by right-clicking the uncharged ring and selecting "Charge" within the Firemaking skill plot area of the Clan Citadel, which requires a tier 3 Citadel. A new uncharged ring can only be obtained after this one has been used up.

It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Fletching skill.

Players may use the pyre logs, along with a set of shade remains (Loar, Phrin or Riyl), on one of the numerous funeral pyres located to the south and to the west of Mort'ton's centre. tx:
▸ Crafting strategy
Crafting nature runes is a members only activity. The general recommendations for usage of pouches and other bonuses should be followed to maximise total output. There are several specific ways to reach the nature altar. Unless otherwise noted, the "bank" is referring to the bank chest at War's Retreat.
• The spirit graahk familiar's teleport ability to the Karamja Hunter area on Karamja. Travel east after teleporting to reach the ruins. Surge and other movement abilities are not viable to use in this heavily wooded terrain, except directly north of the fence. This method also limits the ability to use abyssal familiars, such as the abyssal titan, which will reduce output. Round trip time from the bank to the nature altar and back is roughly 45-50 seconds.
• The Abyss. With the Nexus Mod active, Surge from the Edgeville bank to the Wilderness wall, Dive (after the Wilderness wall) between the trees, then Double Surge and use Bladed Dive (against skeletons) to reach the Mage of Zamorak. The Nexus Mod will transport the player very close to the nature rift, which transports directly next to the altar inside the ruins (1 square away). Round trip from bank to altar and back under optimal conditions is roughly 25 seconds. Without any movement abilities or other boosts, this can easily exceed 45 seconds.
• The fairy ring network. From the bank, use the cape of legends to access a fairy ring, then use code and travel east until the ruins are reached. Travel north once inside to reach the altar. Similar to the spirit graahk teleport method, dash abilities are not practical. Round trip from bank to altar and back is roughly 40-45 seconds.
• The wicked hood teleport.…

sc: The Ocean's Archer Crossbow is a main hand Ranged weapon cosmetic override that can be unlocked by using an Ocean's Archer Crossbow token or through the Ocean's archer override pack.
The off-hand dragon knife is an off-hand dragon metal Ranged weapon that is dropped by the throwing muspah fought during and after Fate of the Gods.
It may be produced using the Smithing skill or obtained as a monster drop.

Orikalkum armour set + 1.x: Orikalkum armour set + 1 is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

sc: Unfeathered orikalkum bolts are orikalkum bolts made from a single orikalkum bar before a feather is added.
It can be bought from Party Pete's Emporium in the Party Room for 50 coins.
The pickaxe (class 5) from the Stealing Creation minigame is made by using class 5 sacred clay on a creation kiln.
It can be purchased from Romily Weaklax on the bottom floor of the cooking guild for 5 coins.

The Plague Doctor outfit (purple) is a cosmetic override set that could be unlocked by completing parts of the plague task list during the fifth prestige of the Plague Doctor Treasure Hunter promotion.
It can be created with 50 lustrous energy, 75 Divination and 70 Constitution inside of a dungeon of high complexity.
After the miniquest is completed you can no longer obtain this as a drop.
Redeyes's bone is received by killing Redeyes without any weapons or armour during the miniquest Hopespear's Will.
Replica Laniakea off-hand poison is an off-hand ranged weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 5 of the Kerapac Track.

Saradomin armour set (sk).x: Saradomin armour set (sk) is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

sc: The damaged book can be purchased from Jossik for 5,000 coins.
Book of wisdom is created by using all four torn Saradomin pages on the damaged book.
It is created by gutting 300 magnetic minnows.
Serjeant trousers are an item that can be purchased from Stanley Limelight Traders for 30 thaler.
The serjeant trousers were formerly purchased from Serjeant Cole in the basement of the Mobilising Armies office tower by spending 49,500 reward points earned from playing the minigame.
It is a possible reward from opening a prawn ball at a 11/200 chance and can be traded between players.

w: Big event mystery box (Going Like Clockwork)
h: Via blue, white, and purple christmas presents
Via regular and big event mystery boxes
sc: It could originally be received from the Going Like Clockwork promotion in 2017.
Spined gloves can only be obtained as a drop from ranged Dagannoths or through trade.
It can also be given as a reward for completing a farming request from Rhazien.
It is received after completing the final clue of an hard clue scroll trail during the 2026 Halloween event.

The Spring Picnic Shoes is a feet slot cosmetic override that can be purchased alongside the whole Spring Picnic Outfit for 20 egg points from the Egg Hunter's Hoard, starting from the 2024 Easter event.
The stasis axe is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 46 of the Kerapac Track while having access to premier rewards.
The strange lobster is given to the player by The Chef during the Celebration of Fire event.
It can be used on either Senecianus or Gregorovic to obtain a syringe of Chthonian blood.
Toadflax incense sticks are incense sticks that are made using the Firemaking skill that provide a stacking buff.
They are made by combining impious willow incense sticks with a clean toadflax, requiring level 30 Firemaking to create and use.
They require 85 Magic, Defence, and Ranged to wear, but not to obtain.
They may be received after winning a game of Fist of Guthix - an interface will appear from which one of the three hybrid armour gloves can be chosen.
Unpowered symbols are made using a ball of wool with an unstrung emblem.
God books are obtained after the Horror from the Deep Quest and are dedicated to one god; it is possible to have more than one god book.
The part is awarded for completing 2,500 bosses killed, with at least 50 kills on each boss.
Vindictive Blade is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 4 of Yak to the Shadows.
It can be bought from Party Pete's Emporium in the Party Room for 50 coins.
A white unicorn mask is a cosmetic mask available from hard reward caskets.
The severed head is found in the sandpit on Entrana, and was shipped there in a delivery load by Sandy of Sandy's Sand Corp to hide Clarence's murder.
To obtain this hat the player must first kill at least 225 chompies, then talk to Rantz.
The wyrm spike is a unique drop obtained by killing Lava strykewyrms in the Wilderness.
It can be obtained as a reward from completing an elite clue scroll, or as reward from the Giant Oyster.
It can be bought for 200 zemomarks from Thessalia in New Varrock.
